network.serverError: Server error, please try again later
network.unknownError: Unknown error, please try again later

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: There is no local page for this address.

boundary.title: Something went wrong
boundary.description: The application encountered an error. Please try again in a moment.

failure.channelMissing: The channel behind this model has no Base URL or API Key yet, so the request can't be sent.
failure.auth: Your session expired. Sign in again and retry.
failure.network: Can't reach the local service. Make sure the backend is running, then retry.
failure.rateLimited: The upstream provider rate-limited this request — nothing to do with what you did. Wait a moment and retry, or switch channel/model.
failure.upstream: The upstream provider returned nothing this time — nothing to do with your settings. Retry, or switch to another model.
failure.invalidParams: The upstream provider rejected this combination of settings. Adjust them and retry.
failure.modelRemoved: This model was removed or disabled. Pick another model.
failure.modalRequired: Midjourney modal parameters still need to be submitted.
failure.unknown: No specific reason came back. Retry once; if it keeps failing, check the channel config or switch model.
